question: Simplify (64x² - 49)/(8x - 7) - 8x .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: 64x² − 49 = (8x − 7)(8x + 7)

Cancel (8x − 7) ⇒ expression becomes 8x + 7 − 8x

Remaining term = 7

No need to expand fully

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(64x² − 49) ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identity and simplification

**Calculation:**

⇒ (64x² − 49) ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

⇒ [(8x − 7)(8x + 7)] ÷ (8x − 7) − 8x

⇒ (8x + 7) − 8x

⇒ 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Factorization

Break expressions into factors to simplify fractions

Cancellation Rule

Common factors in numerator and denominator can be cancelled

Quick Trick

Always check for identities before expanding expressions
